title: About
meta_description: The story behind Dawn — a showcase of the Renick.Content block editor for OctoberCMS.

data.title: A block editor built for
data.lead: Renick.Content turns content into composable blocks. This page — and every page on this site — is built with them.

data.html: From a rigid page builder to a block editor teams actually enjoy — the short version of how Dawn and the Renick.Content editor came together, one primitive at a time.
Page builders were either rigid or a soup of shortcodes. We wanted blocks that stay editable and render cleanly.
Heading, rich text, image and grid shipped first — the primitives every page needs.
Galleries, sliders, maps, PDFs and CTAs turned the editor into a full page composer.
One theme, many locales — this very site runs on EN and DE, with more a blueprint away.
A quick word on the philosophy that shapes every block and default in the editor.

data.text: Good tooling disappears. You think about the page, not the plumbing.
data.author: The Renick team

data.html: Three principles guide the editor — they decide what ships, what stays simple, and what we say no to.
Every block stays a block. Re-open a page months later and rearrange it without touching HTML.
Semantic markup, responsive images, and sensible defaults — no div soup.
Tailor blueprints, Static Pages and CMS pages all render the same document.
One gallery block, four images, fully responsive — a small taste of the twenty-plus block types the editor ships with.
